product: CAMS global reanalysis (EAC4) monthly averaged fields: monthly_mean 2024 (pm2p5, pm10, tcno2, tcso2, tcco, aod550)
version: EAC4 as served by the ADS
attribution: Inness et al. (2019), CAMS global reanalysis (EAC4) monthly averaged fields. Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) Atmosphere Data Store. DOI: 10.24381/d58bbf47. Contains modified Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service information 2024.
method: Each res-6 cell whose centre lies in the region box takes the value of the grid pixel containing its centre (nearest-pixel sampling, as for the NASA POWER layers); neighbouring cells repeat values. CAMS EAC4 monthly means of 2024. PM is the model's lowest-level (near-surface) mass concentration; NO2/SO2/CO are total columns converted from kg/m² with molar masses.
sampling: nearest grid pixel at each cell centre
